blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A woman was found dead in a refrigerator in an apartment in the town of Rodriguez, Rizal, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said on Friday. The landlord of the apartment discovered the body on Wednesday morning, the PNP public information chief, Col. Allen Rae Co, said in a press briefing in Camp Crame. Citing an autopsy report, Co said the victim may have been dead for six to seven days. He noted that identification cards found in the apartment had yielded no results and were discovered to be fake.
